# Space Encounter › Spaceborne Opportunity

> Choose or roll on this table when you want inspiration for a beneficial encounter or event on a spaceborne journey, such as when you roll a strong hit with a match as you Undertake an Expedition, or if you Explore a Waypoint and find an opportunity.
>
